描述_EN: apart from the five-clawed dragon, the emperor's robe would also most likely carry the twelve imperial insignia: symbols including flames, an axe, libation cups are subtly incorporated in the robe. imperial robes worn by the emperor are often known as dragon robes partly because of the prominent dragon motif this robe, made for an emperor, appears bright yellow, but it is entirely embroidered on blue silk. certain shades of yellow were restricted for the exclusive use of the emperor and his immediate family.
描述_ZN: 除了五爪龙之外，皇帝的袍子也很可能带有十二个帝国的标志：包括火焰、斧头、酒杯等符号都巧妙地融入了袍子中。 皇帝穿的御用长袍通常被称为龙袍，部分原因是突出的龙形图案，这件长袍是为皇帝制作的，看起来是明亮的黄色，但它完全是在蓝色丝绸上绣的。 某些色调的黄色被限制为皇帝和他的直系亲属专用。
